result.instructions: Tools for Murf AI, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the English voices I can use for a short narration."; "Generate a WAV file from this paragraph with the voice Natalie, a little slower."; "Translate these three product lines into German and Spanish.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Murf AI data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run murfai_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run murfai_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run murfai_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. murfai_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: murfai_list_voices
tools.title: List voices
tools.description: List the stock voices for one model: falcon-2.1 (streaming voices) or gen2 (synthesis voices). Returns voiceId, displayName, locale, gender and available styles. Use a voiceId from here in murfai_generate_speech. Murf API: GET /v1/speech/voices.

model.description: Voice model to list: falcon-2.1 or gen2.

tools.name: murfai_list_cloned_voices
tools.title: List cloned voices
tools.description: List the cloned voices in this workspace: voiceId (prefix cln_), displayName, tag and createdAt. Murf API: GET /v1/speech/voices/cloned.

tools.name: murfai_get_voice_clone_status
tools.title: Get voice clone status
tools.description: Check a voice-cloning job by its requestId: status is QUEUED, PROCESSING, COMPLETED or FAILED. On COMPLETED it returns the voiceId; on FAILED it returns errorMessage. Murf API: GET /v1/speech/voice-clone-creation-status/{requestId}.

request_id.description: The requestId returned when the clone was created in the Murf dashboard.

tools.name: murfai_generate_speech
tools.title: Generate speech
tools.description: Convert text to speech with the GEN2 model and return a URL to the audio file, its length, the characters used and the characters left. WRITE action: each call spends Murf credits. Murf API: POST /v1/speech/generate.

text.description: Text to speak. Pauses can be written inline, e.g. '[pause 1s]'.

voice_id.description: A voiceId from murfai_list_voices (for example en-US-natalie).

style.description: Voice style, from the availableStyles of the voice.

locale.description: Language locale, for example en-US or es-ES.

variation.description: Variation in pause, pitch and speed, 0 to 5 (default 1).

tools.name: murfai_translate_text
tools.title: Translate text
tools.description: Translate a list of texts into one target language and return the translations in the same order. Spends Murf credits. Murf API: POST /v1/text/translate.

texts.description: Texts to translate, in order (1 to 50).

target_language.description: Target language code, for example es, de or fr.

tools.name: murfai_delete_cloned_voice
tools.title: Delete a cloned voice
tools.description: Delete one cloned voice by its voiceId (prefix cln_). This cannot be undone: the voice can no longer generate speech. Murf API: DELETE /v1/speech/voices/cloned/{voiceId}.

voice_id.description: The cloned voiceId from murfai_list_cloned_voices (prefix cln_).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Murf AI
prompts.description: What you can do with Murf AI here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: pick_a_voice_for_a_narration
prompts.title: Pick a voice for a narration
prompts.description: List the stock voices for one model, with locales and styles. Check your cloned voices too, then choose a voice ID.

prompts.name: generate_a_narration_file
prompts.title: Generate a narration file
prompts.description: Convert text to speech with the GEN2 model. The reply gives a URL to the audio file, its length and the characters left. Each call spends credits.

prompts.name: translate_a_batch_of_product_lines
prompts.title: Translate a batch of product lines
prompts.description: Translate a list of texts into one target language. The translations come back in the same order. Each call spends credits.

prompts.name: check_a_voice_clone_that_is_still_processing
prompts.title: Check a voice clone that is still processing
prompts.description: Check a voice-cloning job by its request ID. When it completes, the reply gives the new voice ID.

prompts.name: delete_a_cloned_voice_that_is_no_longer_used
prompts.title: Delete a cloned voice that is no longer used
prompts.description: List the cloned voices, then delete one by its voice ID. The voice can no longer generate speech, and this cannot be undone.
